subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork candidate for this Feishu reply-mention bug before ClawSweeper queues a new repair lane?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the only active closing-syntax implementation is a conflicting fork copy of a same-repo PR that previously needed proof and safer routing changes.

options.title: Replace against current main
options.body: Use the fork PR only as context and land a current-main fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection, scope-aware routing, focused tests, and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Ask the fork author to refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase into the target repository and add inspectable redacted Feishu proof.

options.title: Defer Feishu ownership
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu channel bug until a Feishu-area owner can sponsor the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Replace against current main
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR only as context and land a current-main fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection, scope-aware routing, focused tests, and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent merged Feishu parser and thread-context work nearest to the current implementation surface.
